name: OSMTracker for Android™
blurb: OSMTracker for Android allows you to track your journey and mark significant waypoints.
description:
OSMTracker for Android allows you to track your journey and mark significant waypoints. Waypoints can be marked
using a button with a tag, a quick voice recording, a text note, or by taking a picture. The various button pages and
layouts can be customized to suit your OpenStreetMap activities. You can view your current track on top of an
OpenStreetMap background.

Features:

• GPS Track Logging: Record and store your journey as a GPX track.

• Waypoint Marking: Add points of interest with:

• Customizable quick-access buttons

• Voice recordings

• Text notes

• Photos

• OpenStreetMap Integration: View your GPS track over an OpenStreetMap background.

• Offline Usage: Works without an internet connection, ideal for remote areas.

Whether you're mapping new territories, hiking, cycling, or exploring, OSMTracker is the perfect tool for
OpenStreetMap contributors and outdoor adventurers.

🚀 Start mapping with OSMTracker and contribute to OpenStreetMap today!
